question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bag and baggage
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Bag and baggage"** means with all one's belongings or goods. (सामान समेत)

 
 
• **Example: **He left the town** bag and baggage**, never to return.
 
 
 
• **"With all goods"** refers to including everything one owns or possesses. (सामान समेत)
 
 
• **Example: **They moved to the new house with all their** goods.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **By force** (बलपूर्वक): Using physical power or violence to make someone do something.

 
 
• **Example:** The invaders took control of the city by force.
 
 
 
• **Fair and honest** (निष्पक्ष और ईमानदार): Being just, equitable, and truthful.
 
 
• **Example:** He is known for his fair and honest dealings in business.
 
 
 
• **At the service** (सेवा में): Available to help or assist someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The staff at the hotel were always at the service of the guests.
 
 

47:Tc84,
The correct answer is Option 2<
